Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，This phrase redundantly combines a historical time noun with a second time expression. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住了在靠墓地的家：住在靠近墓地的家里，A location follows 住在, and 住 describes a state here rather than a completed action, so 了 should be removed. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟孩子搬家：带着孩子搬家，A parent takes a child when moving; 跟 expresses doing an action together as equals. [vocab list]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 搬了到：搬到了，With a directional complement, 了 follows the complement: 搬到 + 了. [teacher rule: le_placement]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个城市：另一个城市，Use 另一个 for one additional or different city; 别的 refers to other people or things as a group. [teacher rule: bieren]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孩子才五岁：他才五岁，孟子 was named in the immediately preceding sentence, so a pronoun is more natural for a close re-occurrence. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 在那个城市：在他们住的城市，The city has not previously been introduced, so 那个城市 does not have a clear referent; this noun phrase identifies the location clearly. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得她没有钱，孟母 was already named earlier in the same sentence, and no other female character competes as the referent, so use a pronoun. [rule: redundancy_delete]
9. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每天在墓地祭拜了：每天在墓地祭拜，A daily action is a routine, so it takes the zero aspect particle rather than completed-action 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 古代已经是时间名词，后面再加“的时候”重复，改为“在古代”正确。
“住”表示居住状态应说“住在”，不能说“住了在”，而改后的地点表达也正确。
母亲“跟孩子搬家”可以自然地表示和孩子一起搬家，并不要求改成“带着孩子”。
趋向补语结构中“了”应放在“到”后面，所以“搬到了”正确。
这里表示搬去另一座城市，应使用“另一个”而不是“别一个”。
前句已提到孟子，后句用“孩子”指代不够明确，改为“他”符合近距离重复指代规则。
“那个城市”此前没有明确所指，改为“他们住的城市”明确了地点。
同一句中已提到孟母，后面无竞争女性指称时应使用“她”。
“每天”表示习惯性、重复性的动作，不应使用完成体“了”。
